info.title: Smart Farm API
info.description: Multi-farm livestock health and farm management API. Every farm-scoped request must send the X-Farm-ID header with a farm the user belongs to.

get.description:
CRUD for a farm-owned model. Queries are filtered by the active farm twice: explicitly
here and implicitly by the model manager. Deletes are soft deletes.

parameters.name: X-Farm-ID
parameters.description: ID of the active farm. Must be a farm the user belongs to.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: A search term.
